subject: Vendor onboarding: security & privacy docs needed for BrightArc
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightarc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Feb 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial vendor onboarding questions — Redwood

Hi Marissa / Laura,

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood with our purchasing system and my team needs the security and privacy artifacts to complete our onboarding. Could you please provide:

- The current DPA (or a redline-friendly copy)
- SOC 2 attestation or link to the report
- Current subprocessor list (CSV or similar)
- Any standard vendor questionnaire/portal link if you have one

Additionally: we'll need the name that should appear on the PO and the remit-to billing info. Our procurement team also requires a completed vendor form — I've attached the form we'll fill once we have the docs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
BrightArc Corp
Samantha.Lee@brightarc.com

Attachments: BrightArc-vendor-form.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightarc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Feb 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding questions — Redwood

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the vendor form.

I've attached our DPA (Redwood-DPA-v2.pdf) and the most recent SOC 2 attestation (SOC2-Attestation-2024.pdf) for your review. Our current subprocessor inventory is attached as a CSV (subprocessors-2025.csv).

Quick notes:
- The DPA we attached is our standard agreement; we can accept limited redlines but would prefer to keep the security exhibits unchanged. If you have specific legal comments, please send them to contracting@brightarc.com and loop me in so we can triage.
- SOC 2 is an attestation; if you need more detail (control narratives or evidence), let us know and we can arrange a secure evidence transfer with NDA.
- The subprocessor list includes hosting, monitoring, and analytics providers; each entry has the data classification and region.

For procurement steps we typically need:
1) Completed vendor form from BrightArc (you mentioned you'll attach)
2) PO number assigned by your system (please send PO PDF or PO number)
3) W-9 / tax form (for US vendors) — we will provide if required (we're US-based)

Remit and billing info for the PO:
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Address: 1600 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Remit: accounting@redwood.ai

I'll also include a DocuSign link if you prefer an executed DPA rather than exchanging PDFs.

Action items for BrightArc: please send the completed vendor form and PO number. We'll push this through finance as soon as we have the PO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-v2.pdf; SOC2-Attestation-2024.pdf; subprocessors-2025.csv
From: procurement@brightarc.com <procurement@brightarc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightarc.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightarc.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Feb 2025 14:29:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial vendor onboarding questions — Redwood (PO and completed form)

Marissa,

Thanks — we've completed the vendor form and issued PO BA-88017. See attached: BrightArc-vendor-form-filled.pdf and PO-BA-88017.pdf.

Notes from procurement:
- We reviewed the DPA and SOC2 attestation you sent; our privacy team flagged two subprocessor questions around a monitoring vendor located outside the EU. Can you confirm whether any EU customer data is routed to that subprocessor?
- Please provide the document with the final countersignature (signed DPA) or a DocuSign envelope link so our legal team can close the file.

Please confirm the Redwood vendor ID you want associated with the PO for invoicing. If you prefer, we can send a purchase order receipt to accounting@redwood.ai.

Regards,
Procurement Team
BrightArc Corp
procurement@brightarc.com

Attachments: BrightArc-vendor-form-filled.pdf; PO-BA-88017.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@brightarc.com, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightarc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding questions — Redwood (final docs & invoice routing)

Hi — thanks for sending the completed form and the PO. Confirming receipt of PO BA-88017.

To answer the privacy concern: the monitoring subprocessor listed in subprocessors-2025.csv (MonitoringCo EU Node) is used for aggregated health telemetry only; we do not send identifiable or customer payload data to that endpoint. EU customer tokens and sensitive payloads remain in our EU region hosts unless the customer explicitly configures cross-region routing. If your privacy team wants details, Laura (copied) can share the control narrative and data flows under a scoped NDA.

I've attached the executed DPA (Redwood-DPA-signed.pdf) and an updated subprocessor export (subprocessors-2025.csv) referencing the MonitoringCo EU Node entry with the added comment about data types. For signature convenience here is the DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/room/abc123-redwood-dpa (also in related links).

Invoice routing: please send PO invoices to accounting@redwood.ai and reference vendor ID: RDW-000311 in the invoice. We'll confirm once the invoice is received and the vendor record is active in our system.

If anything else is required to close the onboarding ticket, call out specific asks and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-signed.pdf; subprocessors-2025.csv
